page_title: BOL 1-1 JUV | Bologna v Juventus 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Santiago Castro (Bologna) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
90+4' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Alberto Costa (Juventus) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Riccardo Orsolini will be replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
88' Substitution. Davide Calabria (Bologna) replaces Lorenzo De Silvestri.
87' The game has come to an end for Randal Kolo Muani. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
86' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Timothy Weah will be replaced by Vasilije Adzic (Juventus).
85' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remo Freuler departs the field of play to be replaced by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna).
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Santiago Castro (Bologna) for Jens Odgaard.
77' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) replacing Nicolas Gonzalez.
77' Here comes a substitution. Manuel Locatelli is given a rest as he is replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
76' Alberto Costa (Juventus) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Lukasz Skorupski.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
74' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Bologna.
71' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Andrea Cambiaso leaves the pitch to be replaced by Alberto Costa (Juventus).
67' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) comes onto the pitch after Juan Miranda signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
65' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes.
63' 68:32 – the latest ball possession ratio.
58' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Remo Freuler (Bologna) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Michele Di Gregorio. He makes it 1:1.
51' The Juventus players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Daniele Doveri signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
51' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Daniele Doveri wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
50' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
49' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) leaps to collect the ball.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Bologna have a corner.
48' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
46' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Daniele Doveri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Randal Kolo Muani, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
43' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
41' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
40' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
40' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
39' 63:37 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Juventus.

35' Sam Beukema (Bologna) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
35' Bologna will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
32' Some patient build-up play from Bologna as they look to unlock the defence.
30' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
29' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
26' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
26' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
25' Bologna produce a short pass from the free kick.
24' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Doveri signals. Bologna get a free kick.
22' The defence successfully catches Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) in the offside trap, but it was close!
21' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
19' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
18' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
16' Lukasz Skorupski displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
13' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Andrea Cambiaso tees up Khephren Thuram (Juventus) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball low into the middle of the net. 0:1.
8' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Sam Beukema (Bologna) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save.
7' Bologna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
6' Bologna try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
5' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
3' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
